import_contract.block_index_limit: index uniqueness/order is checked; independent finalized getBlock signature parity is left to root using existing/authorized cache
import_contract.cached_custody_behavior: reuse a frozen custody_extended tape only when its per-mint audit says prepared and custody supported; retain source and audit hashes; caller must revalidate merged custody and block indices
coverage_required: pinned all-status pagination contract for the complete first-hour interval
import_contract.migration_behavior: authenticated local migration remains eligible only when curve history is covered through migration+240
import_contract.nonterminal_first_hour_behavior: accepted as a complete fixed first-hour observation with curve_lifetime_complete=false and curve_observation_complete=true; no lifetime completion is inferred
provenance_preserved: migration, terminal, or fixed-first-hour observation classification
cached custody source/audit hashes when reused
import_contract.returns: collector-compatible raw envelope with original creation metadata/transactions plus coverage and source_provenance certificates
import_contract.rpc_behavior: no RPC calls; no curve requery

limitations: Manifest activity, peak-reserve, buyer-count fields are prefilter snapshots, not authenticated curve measurements.
Queue construction does not load transaction arrays and does not certify any candidate's coverage.
A first-hour nonterminal tape is complete only as a fixed first-hour observation; activity after that boundary and full curve lifetime remain unknown.
The helper does not independently compare transactionIndex with finalized block signatures.

queue.ordering: early then later; round-robin one candidate per UTC day at each depth; within each day chronological by creation_time then mint

collector_contract_provenance.coverage_contract: collect_validation.history queries the bonding-curve address with status=None, blockTime gte creation_time and lt creation_time+3600; it returns only when the pagination token is absent, raises at the 500-page cap, validates each transaction index and time bound, and curve() saves only after history returns.

source.filter_metrics_trust: prefilter only; peak_reserve_sol may reflect decoder/venue contamination and is never treated as a verified curve metric

status: local candidate queue prepared; source remains read-only; no RPC used
